title: SU(3) Braided Fusion Spin Systems and Haah Nets
statement: Prove that the braided fusion spin system associated with $\mathrm{SU}(3)_1$, or with its reverse braiding, is bounded-spread isomorphic to Haah's proposed two-dimensional net of algebras with the specified local clock-and-shift generators.
